## 2. THE EDIT (only the Phase-2 emit block in _phase2_lines; nothing else in the file touched)

Old block (listed only class==DEFERRED_USD_NULL, then a separate FINAL-class list):
    out = ["", "## Phase-2 notes", "", "### DEFERRED_USD_NULL"]
    out += [
        f"- {r['sig']} ca={r['ca']}"
        for r in records
        if r["class"] == "DEFERRED_USD_NULL"
    ] or ["- (none)"]
    null_groups = [r for r in records if r["notes"].get("usd_null") is True]
    out += [ "", f"All {len(null_groups)} truth usd-null groups with FINAL class ...:", ]
    out += [ f"- {r['sig'][:12]}… ca={r['ca'][:8]}… class={r['class']}" for r in null_groups ]

New block (lists ALL truth usd-null groups — 11 deferred plain + outranked explicitly annotated — plus the closing sum sentence):
    out = ["", "## Phase-2 notes", "", "### DEFERRED_USD_NULL"]
    null_groups = [r for r in records if r["notes"].get("usd_null") is True]
    out += [
        f"- {r['sig']} ca={r['ca']}"
        if r["class"] == "DEFERRED_USD_NULL"
        else f"- {r['sig']} ca={r['ca']} — truth usd-null OUTRANKED by "
        f"{r['class']} (CLASS_PRECEDENCE)"
        for r in null_groups
    ] or ["- (none)"]
    n_def = sum(1 for r in null_groups if r["class"] == "DEFERRED_USD_NULL")
    n_outranked = len(null_groups) - n_def
    out += [
        "",
        f"{n_def} deferred + {n_outranked} outranked = {len(null_groups)} "
        f"truth usd-null, no deferral lost; G11 False is expected and "
        f"root-caused (CLASS_PRECEDENCE assigns the type/amount mismatch class).",
        "",
        f"All {len(null_groups)} truth usd-null groups with FINAL class "
        f"(G11 root cause — precedence promotes type/amount failures):",
    ]
    out += [
        f"- {r['sig'][:12]}… ca={r['ca'][:8]}… class={r['class']}" for r in null_groups
    ]

Data source unchanged: null_groups uses r["notes"].get("usd_null") is True — the same field summarize() @566-568 counts for n_usd_null_groups (=13) and pass_bar G11 @701-703 compares against cc["DEFERRED_USD_NULL"] (=11). No threshold, no GATE_NAMES, no CLASS_PRECEDENCE, no detection logic touched.
